Торговка споро наливает тебе молока в деревянную кружку и протягивает. Ты лезешь за деньгами, но женщина качает головой.

— Нет, милок, не надо. Считай, что я тебя угощаю. Мы тут проезжих любим.

Тебе неловко, но ты соглашаешься. Спорить совсем не хочется. Ты берёшь кружку и делаешь глоток. Молока вкуснее ты ещё не пробовал. Ты выпиваешь всё и утираешь рот рукавом.

— Понравилось, да? — торговка смеётся. Ты киваешь. Женщина развеселилась, может, она расскажет что-то полезное.

— Давненько у нас никого не было. Как только с заставой это произошло...
ru.6890d638706bcdd070129ba3: Ты в ярости. Какой ещё пароль?! Неужели староста обманул? Тебе надо это выяснить. Или стоит рискнуть и прорваться?
ru.68947a502b9c1677632cbd7a:
Ты платишь за еду, и торговец ловко прячет монеты в кошель.
— Чего пожаловали к нам в деревню?
Мужчина явно расслабился после того, как ты купил у него ломоть колбасы. Это твой шанс узнать что-нибудь про заставу.
ru.689c601038b1721d40107a3b: Ты уже был на поле боя и видел кольцо, которое так нужно старосте. Нужно было тогда его забирать, но кто ж знал?
ru.689c604096749cc24fa89d85: Ты уже был на поле боя, но никакого кольца не видел. С другой стороны, ты его и не искал.
ru.689c6072aea239d5c19750ee:
Поле боя встречает тебя сотней одновременных звуков. За время твоего отсутствия ничего не изменилось, разве что запах стал сильнее. Ты морщишься, поводишь плечами и направляешься сразу к лежащим телам. Нет смысла медлить.

Погибший воин лежит на земле, пропитанной кровью. Ты присаживаешься рядом, в этот раз готовый снять с него кольцо.
ru.689c61411a52f71a5611a1aa:
Ты возвращаешься на поле боя. Оно встречает тебя сотней звуков и жутким запахом. Тебе приходится прикрыть нос и рот рукавом.

Ты осматриваешься по сторонам. Где стоит искать кольцо?
ru.689c614d91a5f755532ca989: В прошлый раз ты осматривал только труп лошади, а потом ушёл прочь. Рядом с ней точно не будет никаких колец.
ru.689c6201741098dfb19e53af: Может быть, того богатого парня придавило лошадью?
ru.689c62effc2cb2251deced4a:
Ты направляешь свой взгляд на несколько трупов, лежащих на залитой кровью земле, а потом подходишь ближе. Один из мужчин привлекает твоё внимание богатыми одеяниями.

Ты присаживаешься рядом. Смрад лежащих на солнце тел ударяет тебе в нос сильнее. Приходится задержать дыхание, пока ты осматриваешь руки трупа.

Кольцо обнаруживается быстро.
ru.689c98c3a9d3088c05acab1e:
Конечно, ты хотел съесть колбасу сам, просто попозже, но ситуация требует жертв. И ты готов на них пойти.

Кусок колбасы, вытащенный из походного мешка, летит за забор. Собака сначала отшатывается от него, но потом, уловив запах, подступает ближе. И вцепляется в еду так, будто её не кормили несколько лет.
ru.689c997a10ec4dc751719b80: Собака занята свалившейся на неё едой, а это значит, что путь к хозяйскому дому свободен. Ты осторожно открываешь калитку и заходишь на территорию.
ru.689c9a769cdf67444b65e317:
Из дома выходит мужчина. На вид ему лет сорок. Высокий, с широкими плечами и пузом, обтянутым рубахой. Ты сразу понимаешь, что перед тобой староста деревни.

— Это что такое? Вздумал моего пса кормить? А охранять он как будет? На сытый желудок не получится!

Он пинает собаку, отгоняя от колбасы. Та взвизгивает, но послушно отходит, жадно смотря на недоеденный кусок.

— Но за смекалку хвалю, — староста осматривает тебя и кивает себе за спину, — Пошли в дом, расскажешь зачем пришёл.
ru.689c9abe2757883b7baa7ad0:
Ты заходишь внутрь вместе со старостой. В доме тепло и пахнет свежим хлебом. Староста не предлагает тебе присесть на лавку.

— Кем будешь и куда путь держишь? Я тебя в деревне не видел.
ru.689f4847426c274c0b679373: Ты смотришь на мужика перед собой и понимаешь, что не стоит рисковать. Тебя же просто убьют и даже не почешутся! Нет, лучше навестить старосту снова и спросить, что за игры он ведёт.
ru.689f489c146f270489c38257:
Ты выходишь от старосты с пустыми руками. Что теперь делать? Где искать какой-то пароль?

Наверняка во всей ситуации есть двойное дно, добравшись до которого ты сможешь пройти дальше. Весь этот мир словно создан из сплошных загадок. Но разве так не интереснее?

Ты понимаешь, что надо думать. Может быть, стоит отдохнуть. Или обратиться за помощью к кому-нибудь из своих друзей, оставшихся за границами твоего пути.
ru.689f48de3b47a5cc734addec:
Тебе некогда бегать туда-сюда и выяснять какой-то пароль. Поэтому ты решаешь действовать.

Ты бросаешься вперёд, отталкивая мужика со своего пути. Тот явно не ожидал такой прыти, поэтому не сразу спохватывается. Ты бежишь дальше, пробегаешь через ворота заставы.
ru.689f4912e84e2561e5645f50:
Ты бежишь дальше, проскакиваешь через ворота заставы.

Перед тобой крошечный внутренний двор заставы, а сразу за ним — мост на ту сторону. Твоя цель так близка!

Только вот на заставе не один только мужик, которого ты оставил позади. Во дворе играют в карты несколько мужчин. Все они вскакивают только завидя тебя и хватаются за оружие. 

— Куда, блять?! — один из них матерится, а потом свистит.
ru.689f49e9948b799c4f33d808:
Тебе ничего не остаётся кроме как идти до конца.

Словно берсерк ты бежишь вперёд, крича в попытке то ли напугать разбойников, то ли подбодрить себя.

Но ты успеваешь добраться только до середины дворика.
ru.689f49fb899498a7be9cac58:
Ты останавливаешься на месте, не зная, что делать дальше. Бежать обратно? Нет, глупость. Вперёд? У тебя даже оружия нет с собой!

Но сделать ничего ты и не успеваешь.
ru.689f4a07239f2965c3c6c828:
Ты решаешь развернуться. Кажется, ты себя переоценил.

Ты поднимаешь руки и виновато улыбаешься, делаешь шаг назад, но даже не успеваешь ничего сказать в своё оправдание.
ru.689f4bc7037746c8a7d97cf4:
Неожиданно ты слышишь тихий свист, а через мгновение что-то впивается тебе в плечо. Боль такая, будто руку пытаются оторвать. Ты инстинктивно накрываешь это место ладонью.

В тебя прилетела стрела.
ru.689f4c18548d732e5c77d7b4:
Но ты не успеваешь даже вздохнуть, как с другой стороны в тебя прилетает ещё одна стрела. Эта попадает в бедро, и ты припадаешь на одну ногу.

Ты кричишь словно загнанный зверь, просишь остановиться, но третья стрела попадает прямо в твою голову, проходя её насквозь.

Ты валишься на землю бездыханный. На твоей безымянной могиле напишут "слабоумие и отвага".
ru.689f534cb15f1c44c281c955: Ты достаёшь из кошеля один золотой и ловко бросаешь в зияющий провал колодца. Через секунду ты хотел услышать плеск, но ничего не происходит. Неужели колодец такой глубокий?
ru.689f535ba0d559d825f5fc89: Странно, лучше не рисковать и отойти немного.
ru.689f55668f28d43762e2a816:
Ты пожимаешь плечами и кидаешь в колодец ещё одну монетку. Плеска ты не слышишь, а потом что-то сверкающее прилетает тебе точно в лоб, отскакивает и снова падает вниз.

В этот раз плеск есть.

Только что колодец кинул в тебя монетой! Или что-то, что в нём обитает.
ru.689f5623416da0ee0dccbce0: Лучше больше не рисковать и быть осторожнее.
ru.689f5649a4982cf97fab12ab: Надо понять что произошло. Интересно же!
ru.689f565d0e328e5fac59c293:
Ты заглядываешь внутрь и видишь только темноту. Где-то там, глубоко внизу, плещется вода. Слишком глубоко внизу. Неожиданно ты слышишь странный звон из темноты.
Ты наклоняешься ниже, стараясь рассмотреть причину.
ru.689f569a18e77852b9b84b0f:
Ты платишь за еду, и торговец ловко прячет монеты в кошель.
— Чего пожаловали к нам в деревню?
Мужчина явно расслабился после того, как ты купил у него ломоть колбасы. Это твой шанс узнать что-нибудь про заставу.
ru.689f56ae130f4eb0fbb5ac9e:
Ты платишь за еду, и торговец ловко прячет монеты в кошель.
— Чего пожаловали к нам в деревню?
Мужчина явно расслабился после того, как ты купил у него ломоть колбасы. Это твой шанс узнать что-нибудь про заставу.

sk.68743d0df285ae400d661914:
After a few hours of unhurried walking, you see the first modest houses.

Your route passes through a tiny village. Once it thrived from trade coming from Targrad, but the war changed everything. Now there are fewer traders, less money. People are leaving. The road to Targrad isn’t long, but maybe it’s worth at least replenishing your water supplies?
sk.68743d72e63583c86c178242: Yes, it's best to stay here for a bit.
sk.68743d766f1e35975767990e: No, you have everything you need. Better hurry.
sk.68743d7bcb8ce2f65f19987e: You realize you have not eaten in a long time. And your water ran out last night. There is nowhere to resupply between here and Targrad, so it makes sense to stop.
sk.68743d808cc2bdc17eb7d442: You are not going to waste time. You have enough water, and you can grab a bite once you reach Targrad. The message is more important right now.
sk.68743d83ef859469e1da95d7: A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with chunks of meat. Both are working hard to draw you to their goods.
sk.68743d89f31067886c0f6235:
You walk straight through the village, not stopping anywhere. Today looks like market day: various goods are laid throughout the village's center. The locals watch you with a hint of hope, wishing you would buy something. You just keep walking.
At last, an outpost with a bridge over the river appears ahead. But something is off. No Targrad pennants, no guards... You stop just in time to notice men at the gate. Their armor is battered, their looks unkempt. They are definitely not soldiers. Goosebumps run down your back.
sk.68743dbb7c48f120d1b53172: You should probably go back to the village and ask the locals who they are and where the garrison went.
sk.68743dc0a13b10e7875570b0:
You retreat as quickly as you can. The men do not notice you. You have no idea what they are doing there, where the Targrad guards went, or how you are supposed to cross now...
You return to the village and look around. A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with a tray full of various sausages and pieces of dried meat. Both are trying hard to lure you to their goods.
sk.68743dff32194b7a514624e5:
The men spot you quickly, perk up, and shout,
— Hey you, what are you doing here? C'mere!
You come closer.
The men are armed and look hostile.
— So why're you here? Cat got your tongue? We can help you pull it out!
sk.68743e03f6173c9e91a166a0: You don't want to fight. Answer calmly.
sk.68743e07116888f39aef1d7e: Who do they think they are? You have a permit from the head of the Order to pass through all these lands!
sk.68743e231723328dcfa13297:
You lift your chin and walk straight toward the men. They notice you, exchange looks, and frown.
— So, why are you here? Need to get to the other side?
You nod.
— Then pay.
They smirk. One of them holds out his hand. You realize your travel charter signed by the head of the Order will not help here.
sk.68743e259520db6ad8760da8: Whoever they are, you need to get to the other side of the river. You will go to them by yourself.
sk.68743e337348f6ea87d4816f:
— I need to get to the other side.
Yes, a very diplomatic answer!
— Then pay.
sk.68743e513015735bfdcd26b2:
You offer all the money you brought, but the men only laugh.
— Keep those pennies. Crossing costs much more. Come back when you find real money.
You realize it's dangerous to stay here, so you retreat as fast as you can.
sk.68743e552dc86106b95ea59a:
The only valuable thing you have is the ring you found on the battlefield. Maybe you wanted to keep it, but getting to Targrad matters more. You are ready to part with it. Still, handing something so valuable to just anyone is foolish. You ask to be taken to their leader. The men exchange glances and reluctantly agree.
— Do not twitch, or we will cut you like a pig. — one says, and you nod. You really have no choice either way.
sk.68743e5f9b0310596ad63511: You return to the village and look around. A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with a tray full of various sausages and pieces of dried meat. Both are trying hard to lure you to their goods.
sk.68743e83a2b300463c0b3c0f:
They lead you into the outpost. You notice old, dark bloodstains on the walls — looks like bodies once lay there.
In the former guardroom a powerfully built man meets you. He does not take off his helmet, he only turns toward you. A hammer lies within his reach. He could easily grab it and smash your head if you do something stupid.
— Who is this? — the chief's voice is muffled by the helmet.
— Says he wants to cross. Wants to pay you.
— Well then, show what you have. —  the chief is staring at you. You quickly pull out the ring.
sk.68743e92edbae8910c70e855:
You decide you should talk to scum like this accordingly.
— I have the right to pass through this outpost in the name of the Order of the Navigators!
Only your plan does not work in the slightest. There is not a trace of fear on the faces before you, only anger.
— Oh yeah? Anything else you wanna share? — the men close in and draw their weapons.
sk.68743ea9a3cfe66f514a2b7b: "You are obliged to let me through!"
sk.687443b629bc4666cdbdbf7e:
You remember the ring you found and show it. The men calm down at once, though they do not lower their weapons.
— Should have said so from the start. Come with us, you can give the payment to the chief.
sk.687443ef1372b57f63ea8ba0:
You square your shoulders and press your lips together. You feel you need to stand your ground. It is the only way these bandits will get the message.
Only they are not in the mood to understand anything.
— Who do you think you are?!
One of the men advances on you with a bare sword. Looks like you really managed to anger them. You dodge the first strike, slip away from the second, but the third catches you.
Horrifying pain burns as the blade rips open your stomach. Your insides slip under your fingers when you instinctively grab the wound. The very thought of touching your own guts makes you stagger. Or maybe it's the pain?
sk.687443f433e205ef73e9f3d0: You fall to the ground, clutching your stomach. The stench is vile; everything around is covered with your blood. Your head spins and you close your eyes.
sk.68744421f2028b28ea419f87: Hold the ring back for now.
sk.687444455dc8d2e45c7dbfe1:
You hesitate. Will they throw you out the moment you show the ring? You freeze, gripping it tightly in your fist.
The chief clearly does not like that.
He strides up with a soldier’s quick step and grabs you by the scruff like a kitten. Your collar bites into your throat and steals your breath.
— You come here asking me to let you cross and you are clutching the payment?! Who do you think you are?!
sk.68744449d9f37dbfbf13e107:
You decide not to risk it and hold the ring out on your open palm. The chief stomps closer and snatches it. Lifting his hand, he snorts as he studies the ring.
— Nice trinket. Worth a lot. Where did you get it? Although, doesn't matter.
He pockets the ring and looks at you.
— Password?
sk.6874453917d74962c58b3e39:
— The usual one! We won't et you through without it.
The man pockets the ring and turns away from you.
— Don't come back until you learn the password.
They lead you out of the guardroom and shove you out of the outpost.
sk.68744546795167b8dd7e1ebd:
You feel the chief’s gaze on you, even though you cannot see his face. He lets the silence stretch, obviously to make you nervous. You wait calmly.
— Hell knows how you know the password, but it is correct. — he whistles to his men and nods at you. — Escort him.
sk.687445aa419f9d2b6f4582f1:
The butcher perks up the instant he sees you heading his way.
— Ha, we have not had guests in a good while!
You want to ask how he knows you are not local, but he talks first.
— Our village is small. I know everyone. So, are you buying anything?
sk.687445c5251abe1b4f2aa90d:
You decide to take something for the road. A small hunk of sausage will do.
— Great choice! My wife makes it, she's got golden hands! You will not regret it.
The vendor neatly slices off a piece and hands it to you.
sk.687445d8445e961ec32c599c:
You shake your head, and the vendor presses his lips in annoyance. He clearly hoped to peddle something to you. You, however, are not hungry and do not want to spend money.
— Well then, safe travels.
You get the feeling he would be happy to wish you the opposite.
sk.687445f4f684e8fb354425cb: The man won't tell you anything now. You should try your luck with the milk seller woman.
sk.687445faa444ba5c8d9c1376: You should ask about the garrison. That is why you came here.
sk.68744664350e1c269449a1c3:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.
sk.6874467952382aa9a2335664: What about that outpost at the river?
sk.687446888ec9d6fe0e20054c:
The man shrugs and gestures toward the woman with the milk.
— Those are not our people out there anymore. Nastasya will tell you more than I can, even if you don't buy anything from her. She's always ready to chat.
sk.687446a17a50590644cb2e0f:
You say goodbye to the butcher and head to the woman, smiling politely. She knows what you need.
— Well now, what handsome fellow has dropped by our village! — she grins wide. She is missing a tooth. — Here for milk or for a chat?
sk.687446a7de4662956ea7000c:
You feel like this man might know something else, and your hunch is right. The moment you fall silent, he leans in and whispers conspiratorially.
— There is some kind of evil spirit in our well. Along with the water you get strange prophecies. Everyone sees their own version.
sk.687446ca5dadd51c3ab2e0a1: From his reaction you can tell he will not say anything more, at least nothing useful. You missed your chance by not buying anything.
sk.687446d60c21751530b7c21c:
— And that garrison at the river... What happened to it? — you ask casually. The vendor frowns and gives a nervous shrug.
— It's gone. Others are there now. Not my business.
He turns away. You realize you will not get anything more out of him.
sk.687446e4f58e359b0d29f644: Better talk to the milk seller woman. Maybe she knows something.
sk.687446ecdcee65a14557fea0: You should probably visit the village elder.
sk.6874479d8e515bce62c498f6: That is not quite what you wanted to hear.
sk.687447becff7a6c0e98070a0:
You raise your eyebrows. What village nonsense! Talking wells, really? Only your politeness keeps you from laughing in his face.
You say goodbye and step aside.
sk.687447db3031222242ecd14d: Prophecies? You wouldn't mind getting one.
sk.687447e019d0c23ce9c64184: You ask the man where the well is and head there.
sk.687447e60ee6489657add3b0: The well does not impress you. It looks like just an ordinary well. Someone left a bucket on the rim. You wonder if that has anything to do with the evil that supposedly lives below.
sk.687448078e32115e23a6c744: You have better things to do than poke around village wells! Time to get back to business.
sk.68744826c1258ef724175a0a: You step closer. The grass rustles softly under your steps. The silence here is strange and unnatural: no roosters crow, no children shout. Goosebumps race along your back.
sk.6874482f7d639542920336b3: Are you a coward? You should act confidently.
sk.68744833345076425e3d70f5: Better be careful. Who knows what kind of spirit is there.
sk.68744847525c14d94cd7f560: It is not you who should be afraid, they should be! You square your shoulders and approach the well with confidence.
sk.6874484ed7c28385a0bec50e: You think it is better to be overly cautious than not cautious enough. That habit has saved you more than once. Maybe it will save you here. You approach the well carefully.
sk.68744853580b995731cc1875:
You peer inside and see only darkness. Somewhere far below, water sloshes. Much too far below. Suddenly you hear a strange ringing from the dark.
You lean lower, trying to see the cause. Maybe someone dropped something, and it is dangling and clinking?
sk.6874486655062c766eb05024: Down below there is only darkness and faint gleams on the water. You do not lean over the lip, you only peek with one eye. Suddenly a ringing rises from the depths. Maybe the spirit is trying to distract you, but you keep your cool.
sk.6874486b1ec0d473850ace76:
Suddenly, multiple hands appear out of the dark. You notice sharp claws and scales, a bluish sheen to the skin, but you do not have time to jump back.
The hands grab your clothes and bite into the soft skin of your throat. Something pulls you down into the well.
— It is all because of you. Because of you we all died, will die, and will keep dying!
You hear a furious whisper and cry out.
— I did not do anything! — you shout, but the monster only pulls harder. You tear your nails trying to save yourself, but nothing helps.
You fall and fall and fall until you hit the water.
sk.68744881ff9637da0559e6d1:
That is exactly what saves you when the ghoulish hands appear from the dark. You manage to see the sharp claws, the corpse’s bluish skin, the scales. Acting on instinct, you jump back and fall. The hands clutch the rim of the well and stay there. Someone whimpers, then a voice speaks.
— Because of you we all died, will die, and will keep dying. Over and over, over and over. You are death itself for these lands.
sk.687448f58341a32358ea076b:
The voice seems to split and layer over itself. You hear very young voices, bright and cheerful, and old ones, creaky and worn. You do not move — you only watch and listen.
— We will all die. The paper… Cannot. Must not open.
The spirit slides its fingers along the rim and scratches the wood with its claws.
— You must die so that we can all live.
Suddenly the hands disappear. Something splashes in the distance. Someone sighs. You hear the fading words: "we are all doomed".
And then silence.
sk.6874490e17fd456833550cad:
Your throat is dry with fear, but you gather yourself and speak.
— What are you talking about? I only just arrived in this village.
The spirit’s hands shoot up and rake the rim, as if trying to reach you.
— You are death itself. You should have died, fallen from the ladder. You must not reach Targrad. You must not open the seal.
The thing in the well rages, tears at the rim, growls, moans, and cries.
— We will all die because of you. All of us, all of us will die.
Suddenly the hands vanish. There is a splash somewhere in the depths. You hear the fading words: "we are all doomed".
And then silence.
sk.6874492a76b6092cc64498f8: You barely have time to think "to hell with this" before your body moves on its own. You scramble back and jump to your feet, never taking your eyes off the well. The hands still lie on the rim, the words echo from the depths, but you do not care. You run away headlong.
sk.68744935d64af04f28293440: The world around you comes alive again. All the sounds return, birds sing, children laugh. The sun warms your head. You realize the spirit has truly gone. You wait a little longer, just in case, then get to your feet. You cannot shake the feeling that you just dodged death.
sk.6874493e70c4cb4aa82ccc3e:
You only stop when you reach the square by the vendors. Everyone eyes you with suspicion, and the sausage man smirks.
Hands on your knees, you breathe heavily and steady yourself. Calm finally returns and your heart stops pounding.
That thing wanted to kill you. How many has it taken already?
You look around. The village goes on with its life, as if a cursed well does not concern anyone. Maybe it should not concern you either?

sk.6874497ddf1d3ef90c84b70b: Exactly. Best go to the elder now.

You approach the milk seller with a friendly smile. She might know something, so it is best to be nice. Friendly talk loosens tongues.

— Well now, what handsome fellow has dropped by our village! — she grins wide. She is missing a tooth. — Here for milk or for a chat?
sk.68744aa44c4c35fbf56f7138:
The vendor gives a short laugh and plants her fists on her hips.
— You came to the right person! I have been standing here since dawn, tired already, and there's no one even to chat with.

She sighs and looks toward the river with disapproval. You can tell that outpost rubbed her the wrong way.

— When those people came and cut up the city folks, fewer travelers started showing up. Everyone goes around. And you know, without travelers there is no trade. I have to pour out part of the milk, can you imagine?!
sk.68744abdc69bc430bc57648d: "Why not write to the city so they send their warriors to deal with it?"
sk.68744ac56159d48cac2bb0c1:
She waves a hand.

— From across the river. I do not know for sure. Times are restless here, maybe they broke off from the armies and decided to make coin.

She glances around and leans in a little.

— But I think the elder is the one who called them. They're his buddies. He gets a bit of share from them. And we only part with our money because of his scheme!
sk.68744aeb5780841b5fcba45e:
— I would write if I could. Only our elder knows how, and he is not writing for some reason. Says it is better with them. They protect us better than those Targrad guards, he says! But in reality, they just shake people down at the crossing.

She snorts loudly.

— He made a deal with them. Maybe he called them himself. Well it's good for him, he gets some coin. And us? Nothing!
sk.68744af23ea3fc927bbb841a: She keeps talking, and you realize the only person who can help you cross the river is the elder. You need to visit him.
sk.68744ba15c1e3b546f6fd896:
It is not hard to find the elder’s house: it is the richest in the village and rises above the modest roofs around it.
In the yard, behind a sturdy fence, a dog greets you with loud barking. It jumps at the fence, trying to reach you.
sk.68744bd2fd705cffd2ccfce9: Some mutt is not going to scare you! Stand your ground.
sk.68744bdd7d59af6c9f982583: You stare down the barking dog. Not a muscle twitches on your face. It will not reach you, so you aren't afraid. You have seen worse things than some mutt.
sk.68744be19796a94071d318f2:
You decide not to risk it. Yes, the fence can hold, but there is always a chance things go wrong. You step back a few paces, and the dog quiets almost at once.
It is well trained.
— Buddy, what is all this barking for?
A man comes out of the house. You immediately understand he is the owner. The dog rushes to him with a happy yelp and wags its tail.
He rubs its ear, then looks at you.
— Who might you be?
You are about to answer when the elder raises a hand.
— Come inside. We will talk there. The gate is open, come in.
sk.68744c07ba326767b8236230: The dog, as if noticing you don't care about its efforts, growls and flattens to the ground. In a heartbeat it vaults the fence and sinks its teeth into your arm. Pain engulfs you. You jerk back, try to shake the dog off, but nothing works. The jaws are locked.
sk.68744c1d9f97f7b96553ce1c:
— Buddy, back! Sit!
Your savior appears from the house. The dog releases you at once, jumps aside, and wags its tail. You really want to kick it, but you do not dare in front of the owner.
— Good boy, a real guardian! — the man says as he opens the gate and ushers the dog back in. Looking over your arm, he clicks his tongue.
— Apologies. The dog is just doing his job. Come inside, let's see your arm.
sk.68744c3b2942a0c5bc6a9281:
You push the gate and walk toward the door. The dog watches you but does not attack, as if it understands its master invited you in.

Inside is warm and smells of fresh bread. The elder does not offer you a seat.

— Who are you and where are you headed? I have not seen you in the village before.
sk.68744c6dd76753d904aa625f:
Inside, the man, obviously the village elder, examines your arm. The dog did not bite down to the bone, there isn't much blood. The bite aches but is nothing serious. He wraps it with a strip of linen himself.
— You'll live, don't worry. Why did you come here?
sk.68744c87867ad25c390a84d5:
You explain you need to get to Targrad and mention the crossing. The elder smirks and folds his arms across his chest.
— My friends are posted there now. They do not let anyone through, and if they do, they ask for gold. I can help you if you help me.
sk.68744cb6a8b8ead414941f3e: "What is stopping me from going around the crossing and finding another way?"
sk.68744cc1bf880f745acfde1b: "I'll help. I really need to get to the other side."
sk.68744ccceea62ee263f785c9:
The elder smiles in an unpleasant way and laughs.
— If you have three days to spare, you can try to reach the nearest ford. But spring was rough this year, it might have been washed out...
You realize you do not really have a choice.
sk.68744d0e1c15534d022dfe5d:
— Not long ago there was a battle nearby. Turva and Karhu crossed blades again. There was a young man, a noble. By rumor he ran away from Targrad to join the warriors. The battle was a couple of days ago, but that fellow and his men never returned.
The elder pauses to make sure you are listening.
You are listening.
— So. When that fellow was here, I noticed a nice ring on him. You need to find it.

sk.68744db87e93a1c49671fc5f:
The elder snorts at your question.

sk.68744dd2f735dbcfce093ee5: You realize you have no choice. You haven't brought much money with you, so you cannot pay for the crossing. You nod and leave the elder’s house. You will have to find that damn ring.

The battlefield greets you with a hundred simultaneous sounds. You always thought where death had passed there would be silence, but nature has no time for mourning. Besides, mourning whom? People who kill each other over petty grievances?

You look at the bodies, broken banners, and fallen weapons. You press your sleeve to your nose and mouth to keep the stench of death from dizzying you.
Your goal is the ring. But where could it be?
sk.68744dff019ab01607f0341b: Maybe that noble was pinned by the dead horse?
sk.68744e0f4742b1fd2654d01f: You approach the bodies lying on the ground. A light breeze blows, letting you inhale without the stench of decay. Now you can examine the bodies.
sk.68744e13d70299f5be4f9d97:
You approach the horse. The smell is suffocating and sharp, making your eyes water. You look at the poor animal and the broken cart nearby. War shows no mercy to anyone, not even animals.
You circle the carcass and realize there is no rider here, and never was. You should search the bodies.
sk.68744e211a6f316024bec831:
You move closer. It hasn’t rained in a long time, so the ground is dry and dusty. Next to the bodies, the grass is stained with dried blood. Even in this proximity, the wind doesn’t mask the scent.
Your gaze slides over the fallen.
sk.68744e3d12d8003f9a04617c: Saddening. They still had life ahead of them.
sk.68744e4c2d6dd1bbdf590aad:
You shake your head, looking at the bodies with sorrow. War spares no one, neither the young nor the old.
Suddenly, your attention is drawn to the ring on one of the dead men.
sk.68744e50a6ccdab5d239cacb:
You purse your lips, looking at the bodies. You feel no pity: these people chose this path. Any warrior risks ending up a corpse among crows.
Your eyes sweep over the fallen, and you notice the glint of a ring on one of them.
sk.68744e6be27317358e8256eb: You crouch near the body. The corpse lies in an unnatural position, but his eyes are closed and his face is peaceful. You immediately notice that the man’s clothing is richer than the others’. This is clearly the noble the elder talked about.
sk.68744e79f371bc88f8874284:
You look around, as if someone might see you. You’ve never stolen anything, but... the owner of the ring is already dead, he doesn’t need it anymore, but you need it to get to Targrad...
You remove the ring from the lifeless hand.

sk.68744eac4e39769d76e127ba:
You head straight back to the elder’s house. The dog is tied this time and does not even bark — seems like it remembers you. You enter. The elder rises from the bench to meet you, somewhat surprised.

You nod and hand him the ring. You want to get rid of it and leave the village as soon as possible.
He takes the ring and nods at the bench.
— Sit for a bit. I will write a letter to my friends at the outpost. Hand it over and they will let you through.
sk.68744edd1969ad595dada20e:
You approach the crossing with the elder’s letter in hand. This time you feel confident and do not even flinch when they shout. You hand the letter to the man who comes out.

He turns the paper over and over, spits, and takes it somewhere inside.

— Wait here.

About ten minutes later he returns.

— Turn around. — he hands crosses his arms, — Now beat it.
sk.68744ff5d8199af339657f71:
You return to the elder’s house. The dog on the threshold lifts its head in surprise. Seems like it did not expect to see you again.

You burst into the house. The elder jumps up at once and frowns. You demand the password.

— What password? There was no password! — he is not a good liar. — Think about it. Why would I do that? I got what I wanted. I do not need you here. I know no passwords. Now get out of my house.
sk.6874501cea1c4db9c71af471:

He waves a hand.
— Come on. I will have you escorted to the other bank.
sk.688025ef531ad6db72b2c808:
You hand the ring to the chief. He lets you go at once, snatches the trinket, and studies it through the slits of his helmet.
— Should've done that from the start. — The ring disappears into his belt pouch. — Now say the password.
sk.68804766a0a3ac4e44f67ef8: — Nah, the letter's good. — the man grins and spits at your feet. — But there is no password. We will not let you through without a password.

The milk seller’s face shifts and she sighs.

sk.6889fd43911515e43c8c2b3a:

sk.6889fd4e0ed088c592ca24cf: You are furious. What damn password?! Did the elder trick you? You need to find out right now. Or should you risk it and try to break through?

sk.689c601038b1721d40107a3b: You have already been to the battlefield and saw the ring the elder wants so badly. You should have taken it then, but oh well.

You find the ring quickly.

You know you need to think. Maybe you should rest. Or maybe turn to one of your friends outside your path for help.

After a few hours of unhurried walking, you see the first modest houses.

Your route passes through a tiny village. Once it thrived from trade coming from Targrad, but the war changed everything. Now there are fewer traders, less money. People are leaving. The road to Targrad isn’t long, but maybe it’s worth at least replenishing your water supplies?
tu.68743d72e63583c86c178242: Yes, it's best to stay here for a bit.
tu.68743d766f1e35975767990e: No, you have everything you need. Better hurry.
tu.68743d7bcb8ce2f65f19987e: You realize you have not eaten in a long time. And your water ran out last night. There is nowhere to resupply between here and Targrad, so it makes sense to stop.
tu.68743d808cc2bdc17eb7d442: You are not going to waste time. You have enough water, and you can grab a bite once you reach Targrad. The message is more important right now.

tu.68743dbb7c48f120d1b53172: You should probably go back to the village and ask the locals who they are and where the garrison went.
tu.68743dc0a13b10e7875570b0:

You return to the village and look around. A woman beside you is selling milk. Right across from her stands a man with a tray full of various sausages and pieces of dried meat. Both are trying hard to lure you to their goods.
tu.68743dff32194b7a514624e5:
The men spot you quickly, perk up, and shout,
— Hey you, what are you doing here? C'mere!
You come closer.
The men are armed and look hostile.
— So why're you here? Cat got your tongue? We can help you pull it out!
tu.68743e03f6173c9e91a166a0: You don't want to fight. Answer calmly.

The only valuable thing you have is the ring you found on the battlefield. Maybe you wanted to keep it, but getting to Targrad matters more. You are ready to part with it. tu.689c98c3a9d3088c05acab1e:
You wanted to eat the sausage yourself later, but the situation calls for sacrifice. You are ready to make it.

The piece of sausage you pull from your pack flies over the fence. The dog flinches at first, then, catching the scent, edges closer. It grabs the food like it has not been fed in years.
tu.689c997a10ec4dc751719b80: The dog is busy with its windfall, which means the way to the house is open. You carefully open the gate and step inside.
tu.689c9a769cdf67444b65e317:
A man comes out of the house. He looks around forty — tall, broad-shouldered, with a belly taut under his shirt. You immediately understand this is the village elder.

— What is this? Feeding my dog? How is he supposed to guard then? He cannot do it on a full belly!

He kicks the dog, driving it away from the sausage. It yelps but obediently backs off, staring greedily at the leftover chunk.

— But I will praise your wits, — the elder says, looking you over, then nods behind himself. — Come inside. Tell me what you came for.
tu.689c9abe2757883b7baa7ad0:
You go inside with the elder. It is warm and smells of fresh bread. He does not offer you a seat.

— Who are you and where are you headed? I have not seen you in the village before.
tu.689f4847426c274c0b679373: You look at the man standing in front of you and realize it’s not worth the risk. They’d just kill you without a second thought. No, better to visit the elder again and ask what kind of game he’s playing.
tu.689f489c146f270489c38257:
You leave the elder empty-handed. Now what? Where are you supposed to find this damn password?

There’s got to be more to this than it seems. If you dig deep enough, you’ll find a way forward. This whole world feels like it’s made of nothing but puzzles. But isn’t that what makes it more exciting?

You know you need to think. Maybe you should rest. Or maybe turn to one of your friends outside your path for help.
tu.689f48de3b47a5cc734addec:
You don’t have time to run back and forth chasing down some password. So you decide to act.

You lunge forward, shoving the man out of your way. He clearly didn’t expect that kind of boldness and doesn’t react right away. You sprint ahead, slipping through the gate of the outpost.
tu.689f4912e84e2561e5645f50:
You keep going, bursting through the gate.

Ahead of you lies a tiny courtyard, and just beyond it the bridge to the other side. Your goal is so close!

But the outpost isn’t guarded by just the man you left behind. In the courtyard, a few others are playing cards. The moment they spot you, they leap to their feet and grab their weapons.

— Where the hell do you think you’re going?! — one of them curses, then whistles sharply.
tu.689f49e9948b799c4f33d808:
You have no choice but to go all in.

Like a berserker, you dash forward, yelling, half to scare the bandits, half to steel yourself.

But you only make it halfway across the courtyard.
tu.689f49fb899498a7be9cac58:
You freeze, unsure what to do. Run back? No, that’s stupid. Forward? You don’t even have a weapon!

Not that you get the chance to decide.
tu.689f4a07239f2965c3c6c828:
You decide to turn back. Clearly, you’ve overestimated yourself.

You raise your hands, force a guilty smile, and step back. You don’t even manage to say a word in your defense.
tu.689f4bc7037746c8a7d97cf4:
Suddenly, you hear a faint whistle, and a moment later something slams into your shoulder. The pain feels like someone’s trying to rip your arm clean off. Instinctively, you clutch the wound with your hand.

An arrow hits you.
tu.689f4c18548d732e5c77d7b4:
But before you can even catch your breath, another arrow strikes you from the other side. This one buries itself in your thigh, and you stumble, dropping to one knee.

You scream like a cornered animal, begging them to stop, but the third arrow punches straight through your skull.

You collapse lifelessly. On your nameless grave they’ll write “Brave, but foolish”.
tu.689f534cb15f1c44c281c955: You pull a gold coin from your pouch and toss it neatly into the dark mouth of the well. A second later you expect to hear a splash, but nothing comes. Is it really that deep?
tu.689f535ba0d559d825f5fc89: Strange. Better play it safe and step back.
tu.689f55668f28d43762e2a816:
You shrug and toss another coin into the well. This time, something shiny shoots back up and smacks you square in the forehead before bouncing back down.

Now you hear a splash.

The well just threw your coin at you! Or whatever lives inside it did.
tu.689f5623416da0ee0dccbce0: Better not risk it again. Play it safe.
tu.689f5649a4982cf97fab12ab: Figure out what happened. Curiosity wins!
tu.689f565d0e328e5fac59c293:
You peer inside and see nothing but darkness. Deep, deep below, you can hear water splashing. Suddenly, a strange ringing sound rises from the depths.

You lean lower, trying to catch sight of its source.
tu.689f569a18e77852b9b84b0f:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.
tu.689f56ae130f4eb0fbb5ac9e:
You pay for the food, and the vendor quickly tucks the coins into his purse.
— What brings you to our village?
The man has relaxed since you bought the sausage. This is your chance to learn something about the outpost.

ch.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.
ch.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
ch.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, frowning slightly. All your scratches hurt, so you move slower than planned. But it’s fine: surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
ch.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.
ch.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..
ch.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
You stop and look around. Surely you turned the wrong way somewhere. You need to go back and start over. You turn around and head away.
But you don’t see the outpost after half an hour, nor after an hour. Anxiety rises inside you. What the hell is going on?
ch.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Finally, you see a hut ahead and stop. Impassable swamps surround it. How could anyone survive here alone?
The house looks well-kept, but somehow... otherworldly.
ch.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
The house is cute and mysterious, but now is not the time to meddle in things that aren’t yours. You need to reach Targrad as soon as possible.
You pass the house and continue onward.
ch.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
You walk. And walk. And walk.
The road stretches ahead like a narrow ribbon, winding among swampy hummocks. You see a structure ahead and approach…
ch.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
...and realize that it is the same house. You even approached it from the same side as last time. Could you have gotten lost? But you remember walking on an absolutely straight road!
This is definitely some kind of magic. And its owner wants you to enter the house.
ch.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.
The first thing you notice is a body lying almost on the threshold. Beyond it are herbs hanging from the ceiling. You realize some witch lives here. You lower your gaze to the body. Or, rather, lived here.
ch.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: To hell with it! Time to leave.
ch.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Better examine the house more carefully.
ch.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
ch.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
ch.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
ch.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
ch.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
ch.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
ch.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
ch.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
ch.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
ch.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
ch.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: "Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter! You creature!"
ch.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
ch.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?
ch.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
ch.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
ch.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
ch.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
ch.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
ch.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
ch.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
ch.68776c901d977782c497b92d: "It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything."
ch.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
en.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
en.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
en.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
en.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
en.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
en.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
en.68776c901d977782c497b92d: "It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything."
en.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

es.687766ebf0699320ec0fe4fa:
Finally, you reach the other side of the river. You look back at the crossing. No one is seeing you off, and that’s for the best. The last thing you want is to see the faces of those bandits again.
You still don’t understand how you knew the password. Surely it was the Lord who blessed you with secret knowledge. That means He wants you to reach Targrad. That means your work is important. This understanding pushes you forward.
es.6877670b53d4a9a319899bf6: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, stepping lightly. Surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
es.6877670d8eed8b191d44bac1: Ahead, the swamps stretch out. The sun hides behind clouds more and more often. You walk forward, frowning slightly. All your scratches hurt, so you move slower than planned. But it’s fine: surely all the difficulties are behind you. Targrad is not far now.
es.6877684bf5462f66938541ce: You walk and walk. The swamps around look so alike that you stop knowing exactly where you are. Half an hour passes. An hour passes. You look at the map and realize you should have reached solid, dry land, but the swamps don’t end.
es.6877687f997e504b36dcdf95: You sigh and keep moving. Maybe the map is inaccurate, maybe you lost your way. But sooner or later, you’ll reach somewhere if you stay on the path. Right?..
es.68776882bbe160d53138531b:
You stop and look around. Surely you turned the wrong way somewhere. You need to go back and start over. You turn around and head away.
But you don’t see the outpost after half an hour, nor after an hour. Anxiety rises inside you. What the hell is going on?
es.6877688f2d23e8bc3a1393c4:
Finally, you see a hut ahead and stop. Impassable swamps surround it. How could anyone survive here alone?
The house looks well-kept, but somehow... otherworldly.
es.68776942b4647b668bb233ef:
The house is cute and mysterious, but now is not the time to meddle in things that aren’t yours. You need to reach Targrad as soon as possible.
You pass the house and continue onward.
es.6877694b344a9779e0e4eebe:
You walk. And walk. And walk.
The road stretches ahead like a narrow ribbon, winding among swampy hummocks. You see a structure ahead and approach…
es.6877695906bf1da56f74700d:
...and realize that it is the same house. You even approached it from the same side as last time. Could you have gotten lost? But you remember walking on an absolutely straight road!
This is definitely some kind of magic. And its owner wants you to enter the house.
es.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.
The first thing you notice is a body lying almost on the threshold. Beyond it are herbs hanging from the ceiling. You realize some witch lives here. You lower your gaze to the body. Or, rather, lived here.
es.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: To hell with it! Time to leave.
es.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Better examine the house more carefully.
es.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
es.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
es.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
es.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
es.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
es.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
es.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
es.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
es.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
es.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
es.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: "Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter! You creature!"
es.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
es.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?

ge.687769673ee96886e458b3eb:
The door is slightly open. You push it and step inside.

ge.687769a706b143c57b8037cd: To hell with it! Time to leave.
ge.687769b96724922b7c3a977d: Better examine the house more carefully.
ge.687769d09aa1bbe99a33f796:
You are about to leave and continue wandering the swamps in search of an exit, when suddenly some force pulls you back.
"Help me..."
You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
ge.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
ge.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
ge.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
ge.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
ge.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
ge.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
ge.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
ge.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
ge.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
ge.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: "Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter! You creature!"
ge.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
ge.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?
ge.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
ge.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
ge.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
ge.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
ge.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
ge.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:
The ghostly girl nods.
— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
ge.68776c815950c83fded8767a:
— Help me, and I will let you go, — the ghost flickers between clarity and a ripple, like a lake disturbed by a thrown stone.
You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
ge.68776c901d977782c497b92d: "It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything."
ge.68776c9fc271e98e8ef3d76a: — I mean myself! Not the body. — the ghost shifts for a moment. You flinch as a bloodthirsty snarl flashes across her face, but a second later, her expression is calm again. It seems she dislikes useless questions. Best remember that.

You shiver and look around. A whisper, you definitely heard it! But there’s no one around, only… You look at the body. Goosebumps run down your spine. It seems someone — or something — doesn’t want to let you go easily. You simply have no choice.
kr.687769e87fd67688da56cfc1: Better examine the house more carefully.
kr.687769f769b0ec97a0682d05:
You move further. The hut is clearly meant for one person: you find only one bed, one set of wooden dishes. Everything here is imbued with magic and unexpectedly homely comfort. No strange cauldrons with suspicious brews, no devilish marks, no black cats or roosters. If this hut weren’t standing on swamp stumps, you would never distinguish it from any regular village house.
You find nothing interesting.
kr.68776a1371aceff1114f9edf: You approach and stand directly over the corpse. A young woman lies face down, a sword protruding from her back. No one would voluntarily leave their weapon in a corpse. You look at the sword and realize it’s quite expensive.
kr.68776a53f94c9d419ec4b9d4: You approach and grab the sword’s hilt. Suddenly, your palms are burned by a cold like nothing you’ve ever felt. Reflexively, you pull your hands back.
kr.68776a5e2319985d4d57c354: Perhaps it's better not try this again.
kr.68776a6fcc97fe1f9012c020: You decide to leave the sword in place. Something inside you resists the idea of further mutilating the body of a stranger. Perhaps you should even move her and bury her in the yard.
kr.68776a896c8e2be82eb23fd7: But before you can bend down, a ghost rises from the body right before you. You recoil, unsure what to do.
kr.68776aa6b1d9b19c4f986bbc:
You ignore the warning. Ahead lies the path to Targrad. Surely the bandits from the crossing are not the only ones who exploited the city’s weakness. You need the sword more than the cold corpse.
You grab the hilt again, clenching your teeth against the cold, and pull the sword out. It slides from the body.
kr.68776ab0ae2b125a0898bbfc:
Suddenly, a wave of force throws you back. You hit the wall and catch your breath. Before you, the ghost of the murdered woman rises. The hut grows so cold that you start shivering. Or is it fear?
The ghost’s face is twisted in rage.
—How dare you mock the body of an innocent victim?!
kr.68776b3da3fae9cbf8be4b29: "Don’t come near, you ghoulish specter! You creature!"
kr.68776b4b13febab7d8bdc1cc: The ghost laughs. Her laughter echoes through the hut, sending chills down your spine. What do you do?
kr.68776b50260dd115ac338e51:
The ghost does not answer, only smiles. You see not a corpse, but a young woman. But don’t be deceived, you remind yourself, evil spirit remains evil spirit.
What do you do?
kr.68776b9b9831684f832bba27:
You decide to take a risk. The hut’s exit is very close, you can make it.
You jump to your feet and rush for the open door.
Bang — the door closes right in front of you. You tug the handle, but it doesn’t budge.
— Do not run. You won’t succeed anyway. You are on my territory.
You turn to the ghost. Suddenly, you realize something.
kr.68776b9d6a7c1975fec78b1e:
You freeze in place, staring at the ghost. She tilts her head slightly and leans toward you.
— Good thing you didn’t run.
Her voice echoes somewhere in your head. You don’t look away.
— You are on my territory anyway.
Suddenly, you realize something.
kr.68776bab64c7af8a31e15fc3:
But your words pass the ghost by. You see frost tracing paths from her body toward you. The woman’s ghost roars and lunges at you. In a second, her semi-transparent hand plunges into your chest.
You expect pain, but a second passes, then another... and nothing happens. The ghost recoils and hovers again over the body.
kr.68776be609bb97fe9897d4c4:
The ghost smiles, and a wave of anxiety hits you. Why is she smiling? Her attack didn't work! You are alive and…
Suddenly, pain pierces your chest. You stagger. The pain radiates to your back and arm. The ghost’s smile widens.
— What about now? Do you like it?
You hear her otherworldly voice as you fall to your knees. Breathing is now impossible. You barely understand what happened before consciousness leaves you.
As does your life.
kr.68776bf436f95980e2f53933: Is it your doing that I can’t get out of the swamps?
kr.68776c7650ab4fd648bdcecc:

— You won’t leave here until I allow it.
And you realize she is not lying. But why does she need all this?
kr.68776c815950c83fded8767a:

You involuntarily glance at the body lying beneath her.
kr.68776c901d977782c497b92d: "It doesn’t look like I can help you with anything."
